races.paceDynamic: Le Coq Hardi emerges as the clear pace angle with his prominent style and Henry De Bromhead's strong strike rate, likely to dictate from the front alongside fellow prominent runners Coyote Spirit, Following Orders, Impero and Londonofficecallin. This creates a genuine pace scenario rather than a crawl, with multiple horses wanting to be handy early over this 2m4f trip on yielding to soft ground. The sustained pace will set up perfectly for the hold-up horses to deliver late kicks, with Ephesus, Finnfaraway, Road To The Weir and Glen To Glen all possessing the tactical speed to benefit from a strong gallop. This race shape strongly favours the hold-up brigade who can track the pace battle and pounce late.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will perfectly suit the patient tactics of the hold-up horses who can time their challenges perfectly. Ephesus and Glen To Glen are best positioned to capitalize on this scenario with their proven finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Midfield Tracker Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses early and becomes stop-start
scenarios.body: A horse tracking in behind the leaders but not committed to hold-up tactics could benefit from the tactical positioning. Positive Energy's recent form suggests he could profit from this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Le Coq Hardi can dominate from the front without serious pressure
scenarios.body: His class edge and De Bromhead's tactical nous could see him control the race from flag to finish. The 25-day break should have him spot-on for this assignment.

races.paceDynamic: Ol Man Dingle will attempt to dictate terms from the front with his proven front-running style, though several prominent racers including Riaan, Boston Rover and Drumgill will track closely and apply pressure from early stages. The 2m4f trip on soft ground will create a searching gallop that gradually intensifies, with multiple horses capable of pressing the pace throughout. With no genuine hold-up specialists in the field bar Indiana Jones and Gaelic Arc, this becomes a test of sustained stamina rather than a sprint finish. This race shape strongly favours prominent racers who can travel well in the leading group and have the stamina reserves to respond when the pace intensifies in the final half-mile.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Grind
scenarios.trigger: If Ol Man Dingle sets a solid gallop and the prominent brigade travel well behind him through halfway.
scenarios.body: The soft ground and trip will find out those lacking stamina reserves as the pace never relents, favouring horses with proven staying power who can grind out a finish. Boston Rover and Rising Dust have the class and stamina profiles to thrive in this demanding test.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pace Collapse
scenarios.trigger: If Ol Man Dingle goes too fast early or the prominent racers fail to apply sustained pressure.
scenarios.body: The race becomes more tactical with a sprint finish developing, allowing fresher horses who haven't been involved in early pace battles to strike late. Warriors Wood and Milan Forth can benefit from their recent form and lighter weights in a more tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominance
scenarios.trigger: If Ol Man Dingle gets an easy lead and the field fails to apply enough pressure through the middle stages.
scenarios.body: The front-runner builds an unassailable advantage as the chasing pack leaves their challenges too late on the testing ground. Ol Man Dingle's class advantage tells when allowed to dictate his own fractions in the testing conditions.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Late Surge Special
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace is moderate and the race develops into a cavalry charge from the back.
scenarios.body: Indiana Jones and Gaelic Arc can use their hold-up styles to devastating effect if the race falls apart in front of them. The experienced duo benefit from a truly-run race where their stamina reserves prove decisive.

races.paceDynamic: With no confirmed front runner in this 17-runner field, the early pace will likely be modest as horses with hold-up and midfield styles dominate the entries. Sharu and Undertheinfluence may drift forward by default, but neither shows strong early pace, creating a tactical crawl through the early stages. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses with tactical speed who can weave through traffic and produce a telling late burst.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Messy Tactical Affair
scenarios.trigger: If jockeys get too cute and nobody wants to make the running early.
scenarios.body: The pace becomes stop-start with multiple horses trying to get cover, leading to a bunched field and interference problems. The few horses that can secure good positions like Sharu prosper while others struggle in traffic.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Surprise Pace Injection

scenarios.body: A genuine pace materializes creating a more conventional race shape where stamina becomes a factor. This could expose some hold-up horses but may suit those with proven staying ability on this ground.

races.paceDynamic: Tango Theatre and Jaadil will lead early with Fr Gilligansvoyge, Joe's Turn and Island McCoo tracking prominently, creating a solid gallop over this stamina test. The pace will be sustained rather than frantic given the distance and soft ground, with multiple prominent runners ensuring no single leader gets an easy time. The large field of 19 runners will string out significantly in the testing conditions, with many hold-up horses needing to navigate traffic problems in the straight. This race shape clearly favours prominent racers and early pace-setters who can avoid the inevitable scramble, as hold-up horses face too many variables over this trip on soft ground.

scenarios.label: A

scenarios.body: The leaders and prominent trackers maintain their advantage as the field strings out on soft ground over 3m½f. Hold-up horses struggle with the combination of testing ground, distance, and traffic in a large field.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.body: The front runners pay for their exertions as fresher hold-up horses sweep through with strong finishing kicks. The soft ground aids stamina types who have conserved energy.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Mid-Division Strike
scenarios.trigger: If pace collapses early but moderate pressure is maintained throughout
scenarios.body: Horses positioned in fourth to eighth early avoid both the pace pressure and traffic problems. They emerge as the field weakens to claim the spoils with well-timed moves.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos and Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers or significant interference disrupts the race flow
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with positioning and luck determining the outcome more than ability. An unfancied runner benefits from a clear passage while better horses are hampered.

races.paceDynamic: Encanto Bruno will lead from the start with no obvious challengers for the early pace, setting a comfortable rhythm through the first half of this 3m½f test. The prominent brigade of Lisnamult Lad, Ballybow, Jacovec Cavern, Toll Stone, and Cobra Queen will sit in behind the leader without applying early pressure. With such a sedate gallop likely, the race will become a sprint finish from the last hurdle, with the soft ground adding stamina demands. This race shape heavily favours hold-up horses and those with proven finishing kicks, as they can conserve energy behind the modest pace before unleashing late.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Encanto Bruno sets his usual modest gallop and the race becomes a sprint finish from two out
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of the hold-up brigade will pay dividends as they sweep past tiring prominent runners in the final furlong. Horses like In Excelsis Deo, Rexem, and Littlebiggie can use their finishing speed to maximum effect.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent horses can get first run on the field and maintain their position
scenarios.body: Jacovec Cavern or Cobra Queen could capitalize on their handy position by quickening before the hold-up horses get organized. Their class and tactical positioning gives them the edge in a sustained drive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Encanto Bruno Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If the leader's stamina proves superior and he can resist all challengers in the straight
scenarios.body: McConnell's gelding uses his 10-day freshness advantage to dictate throughout and find extra when challenged. His front-running style becomes an asset if others fail to close decisively.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Longshot Late Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and a forgotten horse produces a career-best finish
scenarios.body: The combination of soft ground and steady pace allows an outsider like Moonovercloon or Dorans Law to produce an unexpected late rattle. Their longer odds reflect overlooked ability rather than lack of chance.

watchPoints.text: Encanto Bruno may not handle the sustained pressure if multiple challengers attack simultaneously in the straight
Watch for any early scrimmaging among the prominent horses as this could set up the hold-up horses perfectly
Monitor Jacovec Cavern's jumping rhythm as he's been foot-perfect recently and could steal a march at the last
Keep an eye on In Excelsis Deo's position turning in as Bolger's horses often produce their best when least expected
Observe whether Cobra Queen can maintain her position under pressure as she's shown a tendency to empty late in tough finishes
